en.title: Vehicle Price and Quote Verification for African Imports
en.seo_title: Vehicle Price Verification for Africa: Identity, Quote Scope and Official Reference Prices
en.meta_description: How to verify a China-to-Africa vehicle quote: separate government identity fields from the buyer's checklist, understand why invoice price is not customs value, and test a used-car quote against Ghana's CIF basis and Kenya's CRSP schedule announced 30 May 2025, effective 1 July 2025.
en.summary: A quote is only verifiable once identity is frozen. Ghana's duty check asks for VIN/chassis, model, year and make, while exact trim and a batch VIN list are the buyer's own checklist; invoice price is not automatically customs value; Ghana's CIF basis and Kenya's CRSP are country-specific official reference points.
en.method: Document research and procurement analysis of official Ghana Revenue Authority, Kenya Revenue Authority and KEBS sources, with WCO/WTO/ICC materials as framework. Statements are bounded to Ghana and Kenya; Incoterms label only the delivery point, specified obligations and costs, and risk transfer.
en.ai_disclosure: Prepared by the AutoBridge Export Editorial Team with AI assistance for source organization, drafting, revision and translation. This is AI-assisted independent review, not human editorial sign-off; final editorial review is pending.
en.evidence_boundary: No first-hand inspection, transaction, interview or ownership is claimed. Other African countries' reference-price tables, the CRSP edition current after 1 July 2025, the exact KEBS consequence for a non-conforming unit, and the authenticity of any specific supplier quote are not verified and must be confirmed before payment.

zh.title: 面向非洲进口的车辆价格与报价核验（加纳、肯尼亚）
zh.seo_title: 非洲车辆价格核验：身份、报价范围与官方参考价
zh.meta_description: 如何核验中国到非洲的车辆报价：区分政府身份字段与买方清单，理解发票价为何不等于完税价格，并把二手车报价对照加纳 CIF 基准与肯尼亚 2025-05-30 公告、2025-07-01 生效的 CRSP 表。
zh.summary: 报价只有在身份被冻结后才可核验。加纳税款核查要求 VIN/车架号、型号、年份与品牌，确切配置与批量 VIN 清单则是买方自己的清单；发票价不自动等于完税价格；加纳 CIF 基准与肯尼亚 CRSP 是各自国别的官方参照点。
zh.method: 针对加纳税务局、肯尼亚税务局与 KEBS 官方来源做文献研究与采购分析，WCO/WTO/ICC 材料仅作框架；表述限定于加纳与肯尼亚，Incoterms 仅标注交付点、特定义务与费用划分及风险转移。
zh.ai_disclosure: 由 AutoBridge Export Editorial Team 编写，AI 协助完成来源整理、起草、修订与翻译。这是 AI 辅助的独立审阅，并非人工编辑签发，最终编辑审阅仍在进行中。
zh.evidence_boundary: 本页不主张任何一手检测、交易、采访或持有经历。其他非洲国家的参考价格表、CRSP 在 2025-07-01 之后的当前版本、不合格车辆的确切 KEBS 处置结果，以及任何具体供应商报价的真实性均未核实，付款前须确认。
